usage_collection types

FilterType

Types used to categorize usage log records; loggers can use them to filter the records they receive.

Name Value Description
FilterType.STREAM 1
FilterType.REST 2
FilterType.SYNC 3
FilterType.ASYNC 4
FilterType.LAYER_ACCESS 5
FilterType.LAYER_CONTENT 6
FilterType.LAYER_DELIVERY 7
FilterType.INIT 8

LoggerConfig

This class is used to store the configuration for a single user logger.

Available as lseg.data.usage_collection.LoggerConfig.

Syntax

LoggerConfig(
    logger_type: type[AbstractUsageLogger],
    args: tuple = <factory>,
    kwargs: dict = <factory>,
    filters: set[FilterType] = <factory>,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
logger_type type[AbstractUsageLogger] Yes Class of the user logger, instantiated by the usage logger.
args tuple No <factory> Positional arguments used to instantiate the logger.
kwargs dict No <factory> Keyword arguments used to instantiate the logger.
filters set[FilterType] No <factory> Filters of the records the logger receives; if empty, all records are passed.

RecordData

This class is used to store the data for a single log record.

Available as lseg.data.usage_collection.RecordData.

Syntax

RecordData(args: tuple = <factory>, kwargs: dict = <factory>, result: object = None) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
args tuple No <factory> Positional arguments of the logged call.
kwargs dict No <factory> Keyword arguments of the logged call.
result object No None Result of the logged call.

StreamUsageKey

Key identifying a stream by stream id, service and item name, used to count stream messages.

Available as lseg.data.usage_collection.StreamUsageKey.
